decisions.reason: As a close extension in a growing industry, Product A likely meets aspirations and the firm's slack allows retention.
Product B is close to the established offer and the industry is expanding, so results likely compare favorably with aspirations.
Product C is another close-to-core condenser, so it is judged against strong past performance and kept.
Product D builds on established repair capabilities and is carried by organizational slack despite some niche uncertainty.
As a product line of customized air coolers, Product E extends the core offer and meets aspirations.
Product F is an incremental extension of existing heat exchanger services, so it is retained under slack and aspiration.
